stat_system.name: SP
stat_system.note: Champions replaced EVs/IVs with Stat Points. At level 50 one SP is exactly +1 to that stat. Formulas live in pkcm.engine.stats.

clauses.species_clause: no two Pokemon sharing a base species
clauses.item_clause: no two Pokemon holding the same item
clauses.sleep_moves_clause: moves that inflict sleep are banned
clauses.evasion_clause: moves that raise evasion are banned

order: remaining HP as a share of that side's starting HP
time_over_decision.note: Tiers 2 and 3 are separate tests: equal shares need not mean equal amounts.

notes: Terastallization is absent from the M-B ruleset text; excluded from scope.
Legal species and Mega Evolutions live in regulation_m_b.json (generated by scripts/build_champions_data.py).
Singles 6->3 is an official Champions ranked format alongside Doubles 6->4.
Champions removes 194 of the moves Showdown's base data calls standard and changes the numbers on ~30 more; see overrides.json.
